```{r init, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare"}
PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE <- get0("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", inherits = TRUE,
  ifnotfound = Sys.getenv("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", unset = "describe"))
stopifnot(PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE %in% c("describe", "differential", "enrichment"))
OUTPUT_FIG_DIR <- PCA_FIG
OUTPUT_TAB_DIR <- PCA_TAB
prepare_module_outputs(
  OUTPUT_FIG_DIR,
  OUTPUT_TAB_DIR,
  c(
    "01_pca",
    "02_sample_correlation",
    "03_unsupervised_clustering",
    "04_input_audit",
    "05_sample_design",
    "06_normalization_sensitivity",
    "07_complexity_qc",
    "08_literature_marker_concordance",
    "09_raw_fastq_audit"
  )
)
activate_mii_context(environment())
PANDORA_CAN_PCA <- nrow(sample_info) >= 3L
pandora_group_n <- table(as.character(sample_info$Group))
PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE <- length(pandora_group_n) >= 2L && all(pandora_group_n >= 2L)
write_csv_safe(tibble(
  AnalysisStage = PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE,
  AnalysisScope = get0("analysis_scope", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = "all"),
  LibraryN = nrow(sample_info), GroupN = length(pandora_group_n),
  PCAApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_PCA, GroupComparisonApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE
), "analysis_stage_status.csv")

```

```{r pca-plot-helpers, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare", eval=TRUE}
build_pca_scatter_plot <- function(plot_df, variance_pct, title_text, color_values = group_palette) {
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group, label = Sample))
  p +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    geom_text(vjust = -0.8, size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_values, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PC1 (", sprintf("%.1f%%", variance_pct[1]), ")"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", sprintf("%.1f%%", variance_pct[2]), ")"),
      title = title_text
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")
}

build_pca_loadings <- function(pca_result, pca_type, category) {
  tibble(
    Feature = rownames(pca_result$rotation),
    PC1 = pca_result$rotation[, 1],
    PC2 = pca_result$rotation[, 2],
    PCAType = pca_type,
    Category = category
  )
}
```

```{r pca-calculation, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe" && PANDORA_CAN_PCA}
pca_input_composition <- sample_comp_view %>%
  transmute(
    Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group),
    Feature = as.character(MainCategory), Reads, Percent
  ) %>%
  complete(
    Sample = as.character(sample_info$Sample),
    Feature = category_levels,
    fill = list(Reads = 0, Percent = 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info %>% transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), GroupMeta = as.character(Group)),
    by = "Sample"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Group = coalesce(Group, GroupMeta)) %>%
  select(-GroupMeta)

pca_wide <- pca_input_composition %>%
  select(Sample, Group, Feature, Reads) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Feature, values_from = Reads, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, as.character(sample_info$Sample)))

pca_sample_ids <- pca_wide$Sample
pca_group_ids <- pca_wide$Group
pca_count_matrix <- pca_wide %>% select(-Sample, -Group) %>% as.matrix()
rownames(pca_count_matrix) <- pca_sample_ids
pca_count_matrix <- pca_count_matrix[, colSums(pca_count_matrix, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]
pca_matrix <- hellinger_transform(pca_count_matrix)
pca_hellinger_long <- as.data.frame(pca_matrix) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Sample, names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Hellinger")
pca_input_composition <- pca_input_composition %>%
  left_join(pca_hellinger_long, by = c("Sample", "Feature"))

pca_result <- prcomp(pca_matrix, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pca_df <- tibble(
  Sample = pca_sample_ids,
  Group = pca_group_ids,
  PC1 = pca_result$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_result$x[, 2]
)
pca_var <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

pca_plot <- build_pca_scatter_plot(
  pca_df,
  pca_var,
  "PCA of samples based on sncRNA composition"
)

save_plot_nested(pca_plot, "01_pca", "sncRNA_pca.pdf", width = 8, height = 6, view = REPORT_VIEW)

pca_loading_plot_df <- build_pca_loadings(pca_result, "all_sncRNA", "all_sncRNA") %>%
  select(Feature, PC1, PC2) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(PC1, PC2), names_to = "Component", values_to = "Loading") %>%
  group_by(Component) %>%
  slice_max(abs(Loading), n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(FeaturePanel = paste(Feature, Component, sep = "___"))
pca_loading_plot <- ggplot(
  pca_loading_plot_df,
  aes(x = reorder(FeaturePanel, abs(Loading)), y = Loading, fill = Loading > 0)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~Component, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("___.*$", "", x)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = mii_orange, `FALSE` = mii_blue), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Main loadings of Hellinger-PCA", x = NULL, y = "Loading") +
  mii_theme_bw()
save_plot_nested(pca_loading_plot, "01_pca", "sncRNA_pca_loadings.pdf", width = 9, height = 6, view = REPORT_VIEW)

pca_coordinates_list <- list(
  pca_df %>% mutate(PCAType = "all_sncRNA", Category = "all_sncRNA")
)
pca_variance_list <- list(
  tibble(PCAType = "all_sncRNA", Category = "all_sncRNA", PC1 = pca_var[1], PC2 = pca_var[2])
)
pca_loadings_list <- list(build_pca_loadings(pca_result, "all_sncRNA", "all_sncRNA"))
```

```{r per-sncrna-pca, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe" && PANDORA_CAN_PCA}
for (category_name in intersect(c("miRNA", "piRNA", "tsRNA", "rsRNA", "ysRNA", "lncRNA", "snRNA", "snoRNA", "endo-siRNA"), category_levels)) {
  category_detail <- if (category_name == "endo-siRNA") {
    output_all %>% filter(EndoCandidate) %>% transmute(Sample=as.character(Sample),Group=as.character(Group),SubClass=Sequence,Reads)
  } else if (category_name == "tsRNA") {
    tsrna_base_detail %>%
      transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group), SubClass = BaseSubClass, Reads)
  } else {
    summary_all %>%
      filter(as.character(MainCategory) == category_name, SubClass != "-") %>%
      transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group), SubClass = as.character(SubClass), Reads)
  }

  if (nrow(category_detail) < 2) next

  category_long <- category_detail %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, SubClass) %>%
    summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(clean_reads_tbl, by = "Sample") %>%
    mutate(CPM = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 1e6 * Reads / CleanReads, 0))

  keep_features <- category_long %>%
    group_by(SubClass) %>%
    summarise(DetectedN = sum(CPM >= 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(DetectedN >= 2) %>%
    pull(SubClass)
  if (length(keep_features) < 2) next

  category_wide <- category_long %>%
    filter(SubClass %in% keep_features) %>%
    select(Sample, SubClass, Reads) %>%
    complete(Sample = as.character(sample_info$Sample), SubClass = keep_features, fill = list(Reads = 0)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = SubClass, values_from = Reads, values_fill = 0) %>%
    arrange(match(Sample, as.character(sample_info$Sample)))

  if (ncol(category_wide) - 1 < 2) next

  category_matrix <- category_wide %>% select(-Sample) %>% as.matrix()
  rownames(category_matrix) <- category_wide$Sample
  if (any(is.na(category_matrix)) || any(!is.finite(category_matrix))) next
  if (any(rowSums(category_matrix) <= 0)) next
  category_matrix <- hellinger_transform(category_matrix)

  category_pca <- tryCatch(
    prcomp(category_matrix, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(category_pca)) next

  category_pca_df <- tibble(
    Sample = category_wide$Sample,
    PC1 = category_pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = category_pca$x[, 2]
  ) %>%
    left_join(sample_info %>% transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group)), by = "Sample")
  category_pca_var <- summary(category_pca)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

  category_plot <- build_pca_scatter_plot(
    category_pca_df,
    category_pca_var,
    paste0("PCA of samples based on ", category_name, " subtypes")
  )

  save_plot_nested(
    category_plot,
    "01_pca",
    paste0(safe_dir_name(category_name), "_pca.pdf"),
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )

  pca_coordinates_list[[length(pca_coordinates_list) + 1]] <- category_pca_df %>%
    mutate(PCAType = "subtype", Category = category_name)
  pca_variance_list[[length(pca_variance_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
    PCAType = "subtype",
    Category = category_name,
    PC1 = category_pca_var[1],
    PC2 = category_pca_var[2]
  )
  pca_loadings_list[[length(pca_loadings_list) + 1]] <- build_pca_loadings(category_pca, "subtype", category_name)
}
```

```{r unsupervised-clustering, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe" && PANDORA_CAN_PCA}
build_sample_distance_tbl <- function(distance_obj, sample_order = NULL) {
  distance_mat <- as.matrix(distance_obj)
  if (is.null(sample_order)) sample_order <- rownames(distance_mat)

  as.data.frame(
    as.table(distance_mat[sample_order, sample_order, drop = FALSE]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    transmute(
      sample_x = as.character(Var1),
      sample_y = as.character(Var2),
      distance = as.numeric(Freq),
      method = "euclidean_on_hellinger_composition"
    )
}

plot_sample_distance <- function(distance_tbl, title_text) {
  if (nrow(distance_tbl) == 0) {
    return(plot_note(title_text, "No distance matrix could be calculated."))
  }

  ggplot(distance_tbl, aes(sample_x, sample_y, fill = distance)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", distance)), size = 3.1) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = mii_heatmap_gradient) +
    labs(title = title_text, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Distance") +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

clustering_feature_keep <- apply(pca_matrix, 2, function(x) stats::sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
clustering_input <- pca_matrix[, clustering_feature_keep, drop = FALSE]

clustering_distance_tbl <- tibble()
hierarchical_sample_order <- tibble()

if (nrow(clustering_input) >= 2 && ncol(clustering_input) >= 1) {
  hellinger_clustering_matrix <- clustering_input

  sample_distance <- stats::dist(hellinger_clustering_matrix, method = "euclidean")
  sample_hclust <- stats::hclust(sample_distance, method = "ward.D2")
  ordered_samples <- sample_hclust$labels[sample_hclust$order]
  clustering_distance_tbl <- build_sample_distance_tbl(sample_distance, ordered_samples)
  hierarchical_sample_order <- tibble(Order = seq_along(ordered_samples), Sample = ordered_samples)

  save_plot_nested(
    plot_sample_distance(
      clustering_distance_tbl,
      "Hellinger distance between samples"
    ),
    "03_unsupervised_clustering",
    "sample_hellinger_distance.pdf",
    width = 7.5,
    height = 6.5,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )

  clustering_fig_dir <- build_nested_dir(
    OUTPUT_FIG_DIR,
    "03_unsupervised_clustering",
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
  clustering_tree_path <- file.path(clustering_fig_dir, "hierarchical_clustering_ward_d2.pdf")
  save_plot_device(
    clustering_tree_path,
    data = list(composition=hellinger_clustering_matrix,clustering=sample_hclust),
    width = 8,
    height = 5.5,
    draw_fn = function() {
      plot(
        sample_hclust,
        main = "Ward.D2 hierarchical clustering of Hellinger composition",
        xlab = NULL,
        sub = NULL
      )
    }
  )

  if (pkg_has("pheatmap")) {
    heatmap_matrix <- t(hellinger_clustering_matrix)
    annotation_col <- data.frame(
      Group = factor(as.character(pca_group_ids), levels = group_levels)
    )
    rownames(annotation_col) <- rownames(hellinger_clustering_matrix)
    save_pheatmap_file(
      heatmap_matrix,
      cluster_cols = sample_hclust,
      cluster_rows = nrow(heatmap_matrix) > 1,
      annotation_col = annotation_col,
      annotation_colors = list(Group = group_palette[group_levels]),
      color = grDevices::colorRampPalette(mii_heatmap_gradient)(80),
      border_color = NA,
      main = "Hellinger-transformed sncRNA composition",
      filename = file.path(clustering_fig_dir, "sncRNA_unsupervised_feature_heatmap.pdf"),
      width = 8.5,
      height = max(5.5, 0.35 * nrow(heatmap_matrix) + 2.5)
    )
  } else {
    save_plot_nested(
      plot_note("Scaled sncRNA composition heatmap", "pheatmap package is not available."),
      "03_unsupervised_clustering",
      "sncRNA_unsupervised_feature_heatmap.pdf",
      width = 7.5,
      height = 5,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
  }
} else {
  save_plot_nested(
    plot_note("Unsupervised sample clustering", "Not enough variable sncRNA features for clustering."),
    "03_unsupervised_clustering",
    "sncRNA_unsupervised_clustering_note.pdf",
    width = 7.5,
    height = 5,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}
```

```{r cohort-qc-normalization-sensitivity, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe" && PANDORA_CAN_PCA}
sample_order <- as.character(sample_info$Sample)
category_counts <- summary_top %>%
  transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Feature = as.character(MainCategory), Reads = Reads)

count_info <- build_feature_count_matrix(
  category_counts,
  feature_col = "Feature",
  sample_order = sample_order,
  feature_order = category_levels,
  min_total = 0
)
count_mat <- count_info$matrix
count_mat <- count_mat[rowSums(count_mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(count_mat) == 0 || ncol(count_mat) == 0) {
  write_csv_safe(tibble(method = character(), status = character(), reason = character()), "06_normalization_sensitivity/normalization_method_status.csv")
  save_plot_nested(
    plot_note("Normalization sensitivity", "No category count matrix was available."),
    "06_normalization_sensitivity",
    "normalization_sensitivity_note.pdf",
    width = 8.5,
    height = 5,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
} else {
  clean_denom <- clean_reads_tbl %>%
    mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample)) %>%
    right_join(tibble(Sample = sample_order), by = "Sample") %>%
    arrange(match(Sample, sample_order)) %>%
    mutate(CleanReads = replace_na(CleanReads, 0)) %>%
    pull(CleanReads)
  match_denom <- match_reads_tbl %>%
    mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample)) %>%
    right_join(tibble(Sample = sample_order), by = "Sample") %>%
    arrange(match(Sample, sample_order)) %>%
    mutate(MatchGenome = replace_na(MatchGenome, 0)) %>%
    pull(MatchGenome)

  safe_rpm <- function(mat, denom) {
    denom <- pmax(as.numeric(denom), 1)
    sweep(mat, 2, denom, "/") * 1e6
  }

  normalization_mats <- list(
    clean_RPM_log2 = log2(safe_rpm(count_mat, clean_denom) + 1),
    mapped_RPM_log2 = log2(safe_rpm(count_mat, match_denom) + 1)
  )

  if (pkg_has("edgeR") && nrow(count_mat) > 0 && ncol(count_mat) > 1) {
    dge <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = count_mat)
    dge <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
    normalization_mats$TMM_logCPM <- edgeR::cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
  }

  geom_means <- apply(count_mat, 1, function(x) {
    positive <- x[x > 0]
    if (length(positive) == 0) NA_real_ else exp(mean(log(positive)))
  })
  valid_geom <- is.finite(geom_means) & geom_means > 0
  if (sum(valid_geom) >= 2) {
    ratio_mat <- sweep(count_mat[valid_geom, , drop = FALSE], 1, geom_means[valid_geom], "/")
    size_factors <- apply(ratio_mat, 2, function(x) {
      x <- x[is.finite(x) & x > 0]
      if (length(x) == 0) 1 else median(x)
    })
    size_factors <- pmax(size_factors, .Machine$double.eps)
    normalization_mats$median_ratio_log2 <- log2(sweep(count_mat, 2, size_factors, "/") + 1)
  }

  normalization_status <- tibble(
    method = c("clean_RPM_log2", "mapped_RPM_log2", "TMM_logCPM", "median_ratio_log2"),
    status = if_else(method %in% names(normalization_mats), "available", "not_available"),
    reason = case_when(
      method == "TMM_logCPM" & !pkg_has("edgeR") ~ "edgeR package is not available.",
      method == "median_ratio_log2" & !method %in% names(normalization_mats) ~ "Too few positive category counts for median-ratio size factors.",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )
  write_csv_safe(normalization_status, "06_normalization_sensitivity/normalization_method_status.csv")

  normalization_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(normalization_mats, function(mat, method) {
    long_tbl <- as_tibble(as.data.frame(as.table(mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    names(long_tbl)[1:3] <- c("Feature", "Sample", "normalized_value")
    long_tbl %>% mutate(method = method)
  })
  write_csv_safe(normalization_long, "06_normalization_sensitivity/normalization_sensitivity_long.csv")

  pca_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(normalization_mats, function(mat, method) {
    if (nrow(mat) < 2 || ncol(mat) < 3 || sum(apply(mat, 1, stats::var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) < 2) return(tibble())
    pca <- tryCatch(stats::prcomp(t(mat), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(pca) || ncol(pca$x) < 2) return(tibble())
    var_exp <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)
    tibble(
      Sample = rownames(pca$x),
      PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
      PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
      PC1_var = var_exp[[1]],
      PC2_var = var_exp[[2]],
      method = method
    )
  }) %>%
    left_join(sample_info %>% transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group)), by = "Sample")
  write_csv_safe(pca_df, "06_normalization_sensitivity/normalization_pca_coordinates.csv")

  cor_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(normalization_mats, function(mat, method) {
    if (ncol(mat) < 2) return(tibble())
    cor_mat <- stats::cor(mat, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    cor_tbl <- as_tibble(as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    names(cor_tbl)[1:3] <- c("sample_x", "sample_y", "spearman_correlation")
    cor_tbl %>% mutate(method = method)
  })
  write_csv_safe(cor_df, "06_normalization_sensitivity/normalization_sample_correlation.csv")

  if (nrow(pca_df) > 0) {
    pca_plot <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group, label = Sample)) +
      geom_point(size = 2.8) +
      facet_wrap(~ method, scales = "free") +
      scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(title = "Normalization sensitivity PCA", x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = "Group") +
      mii_theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    save_plot_nested(pca_plot, "06_normalization_sensitivity", "normalization_sensitivity_pca.pdf", width = 11, height = 7, view = REPORT_VIEW)
  }

  if (nrow(cor_df) > 0) {
    cor_plot <- ggplot(cor_df, aes(x = sample_x, y = sample_y, fill = spearman_correlation)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
      facet_wrap(~ method) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(colours = mii_heatmap_gradient, limits = c(-1, 1), oob = scales::squish) +
      labs(title = "Normalization sensitivity sample correlation", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Spearman") +
      mii_theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    save_plot_nested(cor_plot, "06_normalization_sensitivity", "normalization_sample_correlation_heatmap.pdf", width = 11, height = 7, view = REPORT_VIEW)
  }
}
```

Raw FASTQ audit status and available metrics are recorded in the output tables. Adapter-seed detection, terminal k-mer dominance, and 3-prime homopolymer signals are library-level QC features from untrimmed reads; they should be used to interpret trimming and dominant-fragment behavior, not as evidence of biological small-RNA tailing.

```{r cohort-qc-literature-marker-concordance, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="differential", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "differential" && PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE && identical(PROJECT_STAGE, "MII")}
normalize_marker_token <- function(x) {
  tolower(gsub("_", "-", trimws(as.character(x))))
}

strip_mirna_arm <- function(x) {
  str_replace(normalize_marker_token(x), "-[35]p$", "")
}

marker_expected_direction <- c(up = 1, down = -1, unchanged = 0, context_only = NA_real_)

literature_marker_panel <- tibble(
  Marker = c(
    "RNA9878", "RNA10696", "RNA10927", "RNA12022", "RNA36",
    "mmu-miR-486b-5p", "mmu-miR-486b-3p", "mmu-miR-143-3p", "mmu-miR-199b-3p", "mmu-miR-6944-3p",
    "mmu-miR-98"
  ),
  MarkerClass = c(rep("endo-siRNA", 5), rep("miRNA", 6)),
  QuerySequence = c(
    "CGGGGCCCAGTAGCTAGCAG",
    "TCGCCATGGCCGCCGTCACCT",
    "TGCACAGAGACTGGAAGTAGCC",
    "TCTGGGCACACCTCATCCTTG",
    "GTTCCACAATCAATCTTCCAGT",
    rep(NA_character_, 6)
  ),
  ExpectedOldVsYoung = c("up", "up", "down", "down", "unchanged", "up", "up", "down", "down", "unchanged", "context_only"),
  LiteratureStageContext = c(rep("naturally aged GV oocytes; MII follow-up for RNA9878/Kifc1/Kifc5b context", 5), rep("naturally aged GV oocytes", 5), "postovulatory aging time-course"),
  Source = c(rep("Mihalas et al. 2019 Aging", 10), "Zhang et al. 2017 Aging"),
  SourceURL = c(rep("https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6555462/", 10), "https://www.aging-us.com/article/101219/text"),
  InterpretationNote = c(
    "Exact endo-siRNA sequence from RT-qPCR validation.",
    "Exact endo-siRNA sequence from RT-qPCR validation.",
    "Exact endo-siRNA sequence from RT-qPCR validation.",
    "Exact endo-siRNA sequence from RT-qPCR validation.",
    "Expected unchanged in aged GV oocytes.",
    "Mature miRNA marker; SPORTS may report precursor-level annotation.",
    "Mature miRNA marker; SPORTS may report precursor-level annotation.",
    "Mature miRNA marker; SPORTS may report precursor-level annotation.",
    "Mature miRNA marker; qPCR trend may differ from RNA-seq in the source paper.",
    "Expected unchanged in aged GV oocytes.",
    "Functional postovulatory aging candidate, not a natural old-vs-young MII expectation."
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    QuerySequenceNorm = normalize_filter_sequence(QuerySequence),
    MarkerNorm = normalize_marker_token(Marker),
    MarkerBase = strip_mirna_arm(Marker),
    ExpectedSign = unname(marker_expected_direction[ExpectedOldVsYoung])
  )

marker_sample_grid <- literature_marker_panel %>%
  select(Marker) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(sample_info %>% transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group)))

endo_marker_abundance <- output_all %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    SequenceNorm = normalize_filter_sequence(Sequence)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    literature_marker_panel %>%
      filter(MarkerClass == "endo-siRNA", !is.na(QuerySequenceNorm), QuerySequenceNorm != "") %>%
      select(Marker, QuerySequenceNorm),
    by = c("SequenceNorm" = "QuerySequenceNorm")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Marker, Sample, Group) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), MatchResolution = "exact_sequence", .groups = "drop")

annotation_tokens <- output_all %>%
  mutate(
    RowID = row_number(),
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Annotation = if_else(is.na(Annotation) | Annotation == "", "NO_Annotation", Annotation)
  ) %>%
  select(RowID, Sample, Group, Reads, RPM, Annotation, PrimaryAnnotation, FeatureCategory) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(Annotation, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(
    TokenNorm = normalize_marker_token(Annotation),
    TokenBase = strip_mirna_arm(TokenNorm)
  )

mirna_marker_queries <- literature_marker_panel %>%
  filter(MarkerClass == "miRNA") %>%
  select(Marker, MarkerNorm, MarkerBase)

mirna_exact_matches <- annotation_tokens %>%
  inner_join(mirna_marker_queries, by = c("TokenNorm" = "MarkerNorm")) %>%
  mutate(MatchResolution = "exact_annotation", MatchPriority = 1L)

mirna_proxy_matches <- annotation_tokens %>%
  inner_join(mirna_marker_queries, by = c("TokenBase" = "MarkerBase")) %>%
  mutate(MatchResolution = "precursor_or_arm_proxy", MatchPriority = 2L)

mirna_marker_abundance <- bind_rows(mirna_exact_matches, mirna_proxy_matches) %>%
  arrange(Marker, RowID, MatchPriority) %>%
  distinct(Marker, RowID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(Marker, Sample, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    MatchResolution = paste(unique(MatchResolution), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

marker_abundance_by_sample <- marker_sample_grid %>%
  left_join(bind_rows(endo_marker_abundance, mirna_marker_abundance), by = c("Marker", "Sample", "Group")) %>%
  mutate(
    Reads = replace_na(Reads, 0),
    RPM = replace_na(RPM, 0),
    MatchResolution = replace_na(MatchResolution, "not_detected")
  ) %>%
  left_join(literature_marker_panel, by = "Marker") %>%
  arrange(MarkerClass, Marker, Group, Sample)

marker_group_summary <- marker_abundance_by_sample %>%
  group_by(Marker, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanRPM = mean(RPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    MeanReads = mean(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    DetectedSamples = sum(Reads > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    SampleN = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group,
    values_from = c(MeanRPM, MeanReads, DetectedSamples, SampleN),
    values_fill = 0
  )

baseline_group <- if (PROJECT_CONTRAST_BASELINE %in% group_levels) PROJECT_CONTRAST_BASELINE else group_levels[[1]]
case_group <- if (PROJECT_CONTRAST_CASE %in% group_levels) PROJECT_CONTRAST_CASE else group_levels[[length(group_levels)]]
baseline_rpm_col <- paste0("MeanRPM_", baseline_group)
case_rpm_col <- paste0("MeanRPM_", case_group)
baseline_reads_col <- paste0("MeanReads_", baseline_group)
case_reads_col <- paste0("MeanReads_", case_group)
baseline_detect_col <- paste0("DetectedSamples_", baseline_group)
case_detect_col <- paste0("DetectedSamples_", case_group)

for (needed_col in c(baseline_rpm_col, case_rpm_col, baseline_reads_col, case_reads_col, baseline_detect_col, case_detect_col)) {
  if (!needed_col %in% names(marker_group_summary)) marker_group_summary[[needed_col]] <- 0
}

marker_p_values <- marker_abundance_by_sample %>%
  group_by(Marker) %>%
  summarise(
    PValue = {
      baseline_values <- RPM[Group == baseline_group]
      case_values <- RPM[Group == case_group]
      if (length(baseline_values) >= 2 && length(case_values) >= 2 && (sum(baseline_values) + sum(case_values)) > 0) {
        tryCatch(stats::wilcox.test(case_values, baseline_values, exact = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(PValue, method = "BH"))

marker_concordance_summary <- literature_marker_panel %>%
  left_join(marker_group_summary, by = "Marker") %>%
  left_join(marker_p_values, by = "Marker") %>%
  mutate(
    BaselineGroup = baseline_group,
    CaseGroup = case_group,
    BaselineMeanRPM = .data[[baseline_rpm_col]],
    CaseMeanRPM = .data[[case_rpm_col]],
    BaselineMeanReads = .data[[baseline_reads_col]],
    CaseMeanReads = .data[[case_reads_col]],
    BaselineDetectedSamples = .data[[baseline_detect_col]],
    CaseDetectedSamples = .data[[case_detect_col]],
    Detected = (BaselineDetectedSamples + CaseDetectedSamples) > 0,
    ObservedLog2FC = log2((CaseMeanRPM + 0.5) / (BaselineMeanRPM + 0.5)),
    ObservedDirection = case_when(
      !Detected ~ "not_detected",
      ObservedLog2FC >= log2(1.5) ~ "up",
      ObservedLog2FC <= -log2(1.5) ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "unchanged"
    ),
    Concordance = case_when(
      !Detected ~ "not_detected",
      is.na(ExpectedSign) ~ "direction_not_evaluated",
      ExpectedSign == 0 & ObservedDirection == "unchanged" ~ "concordant",
      ExpectedSign == 0 & ObservedDirection != "unchanged" ~ "discordant",
      ExpectedSign > 0 & ObservedDirection == "up" ~ "concordant",
      ExpectedSign < 0 & ObservedDirection == "down" ~ "concordant",
      ObservedDirection == "unchanged" ~ "weak_or_unchanged",
      TRUE ~ "discordant"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Marker, MarkerClass, ExpectedOldVsYoung, ExpectedSign, ObservedDirection, Concordance,
    ObservedLog2FC, PValue, FDR, BaselineGroup, CaseGroup,
    BaselineMeanRPM, CaseMeanRPM, BaselineMeanReads, CaseMeanReads,
    BaselineDetectedSamples, CaseDetectedSamples, Detected,
    QuerySequence, LiteratureStageContext, Source, SourceURL, InterpretationNote
  ) %>%
  arrange(MarkerClass, desc(abs(ObservedLog2FC)), Marker)

marker_plot_df <- marker_concordance_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Marker = factor(Marker, levels = rev(Marker)),
    Concordance = factor(
      Concordance,
      levels = c("concordant", "weak_or_unchanged", "discordant", "direction_not_evaluated", "not_detected")
    )
  )

if (nrow(marker_plot_df) > 0) {
  marker_plot <- ggplot(marker_plot_df, aes(x = Marker, y = ObservedLog2FC, fill = Concordance)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = mii_neutral_line, linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        concordant = mii_green,
        weak_or_unchanged = mii_orange,
        discordant = mii_red,
        direction_not_evaluated = mii_purple,
        not_detected = mii_neutral_line
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Literature marker panel: ", case_group, " vs ", baseline_group),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Observed log2FC from RPM",
      fill = "Status"
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  save_plot_nested(marker_plot, "08_literature_marker_concordance", "literature_marker_observed_log2fc.pdf", width = 9.5, height = 6.2, view = REPORT_VIEW)
}

write_csv_safe(literature_marker_panel, "08_literature_marker_concordance/literature_marker_panel.csv")
write_csv_safe(marker_abundance_by_sample, "08_literature_marker_concordance/marker_abundance_by_sample.csv")
write_csv_safe(marker_concordance_summary, "08_literature_marker_concordance/marker_concordance_summary.csv")
```
